discovery.title: Bear necessities: Indian techie builds wildlife alert
discovery.summary: After his mother was killed in a bear attack in Kashmir, Indian software engineer Mudasir Ali developed an online early-warning system to help people in the Himalayan region avoid dangerous encounters with wildlife.
